id: title:jonmcwest:use each team s message keys when deriving patterns

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a caching layer and dependency recovery mechanism for message key extraction in the ingestion server, potentially improving ingestion reliability and performance.
review.reason: The chunk contains implementation changes, not just documentation. P1.F7.H1 adds a `PatternMessageKeysCache` class with caching and retry logic. P1.F8.H2 and P1.F8.H3 instantiate and use this cache. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement to ingestion reliability and dependency handling.
review.uncertainty: The exact performance and reliability gains depend on the dependency failure rates and cache hit ratios, which are not demonstrated by the code alone. The benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than measured.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. No implementation changes are supplied. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation change: the markdown text was updated to clarify that an empty string is treated as a match, while numbers and objects are skipped.
observations.code_quote: When a log body is a JSON object, PostHog looks up these keys in order and uses the first one whose value is a string as the text to build the pattern from. A key whose value is a number or an object is skipped, and the search continues down the list. A key whose value is an empty string still counts as a match, so those logs share an empty pattern.
observations.posthog_connection: This documentation describes the behavior of the pattern extraction stage, which is not implemented in this chunk.
